name: VividWalls Artwork Color Analysis via MCP Agent

nodes.name: Call Color Psychology MCP Agent
nodes.notes:
This calls the Color Psychology MCP Server running locally.
In production, update the URL to point to the deployed MCP server.

parameters.query:
-- Insert or update artwork with color analysis from MCP
INSERT INTO artwork (
    id, title, artist, collection, 
    description, image_url, thumbnail_url,
    dominant_colors, color_temperature, color_harmony,
    mood_attributes, recommended_spaces, style_attributes,
    color_embedding, style_embedding,
    analysis_status, analyzed_at, analysis_confidence,
    tags, metadata, availability, price
) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4,
    $5, $6, $7,
    $8::jsonb, $9, $10::jsonb,
    $11::text[], $12::text[], $13::jsonb,
    $14::vector(1536), NULL,
    'completed'::analysis_status, NOW(), $15,
    $16::text[], $17::jsonb, true, 0
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    dominant_colors = EXCLUDED.dominant_colors,
    color_temperature = EXCLUDED.color_temperature,
    color_harmony = EXCLUDED.color_harmony,
    mood_attributes = EXCLUDED.mood_attributes,
    recommended_spaces = EXCLUDED.recommended_spaces,
    style_attributes = EXCLUDED.style_attributes,
    color_embedding = EXCLUDED.color_embedding,
    analysis_status = EXCLUDED.analysis_status,
    analyzed_at = EXCLUDED.analyzed_at,
    analysis_confidence = EXCLUDED.analysis_confidence,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;
